issues.title: Acquire complete Garvie2022 ikaite slime-flux study before phase-specific curation
issues.body:
Garvie, L. A. J. (2022), *Seasonal formation of ikaite in slime flux jelly on an infected tree (Populus fremontii) wound from the Sonoran Desert*, The Science of Nature 109, 48. DOI: https://doi.org/10.1007/s00114-022-01818-5.

This is a promising new ikaite owner, but the round81 search acquired only metadata, abstract, a one-page publisher preview and figure captions. No ikaite record is being created from these incomplete materials.

Acquisition evidence on 2026-10-14 UTC is retained in `/private/tmp/cmm-round81-carbonates-research/acquisition1.json`, `acquisition2.json` and `r81open2.json`. The official Springer PDF route returned HTTP200 paywall/article HTML (383510 bytes), not a PDF. The ASU profile supplied bibliographic/abstract context. ResearchGate's indexed publisher preview contains the introductory page and captions; direct acquisition returned403. The OpenAlex response advertises no open-access copy. These are bounded access results, not proof that a legitimate copy does not exist.

Missing evidence: complete methods and results, original claim-bearing Figures1-6 (particularly phase-indexed powder XRD and sample handling), any tables and supplement/data notice, seasonal sampling and thermal-transformation details, and the exact basis for attributing the slime flux to bacteria. Neither generic slime morphology nor a later taxonomic isolate can establish that a named organism produced the mineral in this experiment.

Acceptance requires a legitimate complete original or author manuscript; visual inspection of all claim-bearing figures and any SI; verified IMA/Handbook identity; exact field samples/temperature/storage/phase mixtures; and controls or explicit limits on causality. Preserve co-occurrence separately from demonstrated microbial precipitation. Check contemporary abiotic ikaite experiments before treating a narrow temperature range as a universal requirement. Record original URLs, actual file types, dates and nonempty hashes. Deduplicate against round81 dossier and the complete issue inventory before posting or resolving. A successful acquisition alone does not constitute scientific acceptance.

Round81 curation retains this gap; closing requires the scientific acceptance criteria above, not merely merging the qualified records. The source dossier will be linked from the publication PR.

issues.title: Clarify Pethkar2003 fixer dilution, eluent recipe and recovery balance
issues.body:
The proposed used-photographic-fixer-solutions record can retain the narrow laboratory hybrid recovery result from Pethkar & Paknikar, Process Biochemistry 38 (2003) 855–860, DOI 10.1016/S0032-9592(02)00054-7. The primary original contains unresolved source contradictions rather than a curation error.

- §2.2 p. 856 gives 2.8 g Ag/L and 18.5 g thiosulfate/L before a 1:10 dilution; Table 1 assigns those same initial concentrations to a 1:10 diluted sample; §2.7 p. 857 gives about 280 mg Ag/L after bacterial treatment.
- Table 1 sulfate is 32.25 g/L versus 31.16 in Results and 31.2 in the abstract; no raw sulfur balance reconciles these numbers.
- §2.5 gives 1% v/v ethanol in the cyanide eluent, whereas Results p. 858 gives 10%.
- §2.7 defines cumulative uptake per gram beads; Results reports 43 mg/g biomass. The bead matrix/biomass fraction is unspecified in this paper. The reported 127 mg metal and 70% overall recovery are not supported by a complete feed/fraction inventory or purity assay.

Acceptance: obtain a legitimate author correction, underlying table/column measurements, a fully specified formulation or other primary clarification; verify original feed dilution and processed volumes, analytical fractions, bead-versus-biomass denominator, exact eluent formulation and product characterization. Preserve the original discrepancies and compare the actual same experiment. Do not treat a newly available PDF binary, a review repeating the abstract, or separate synthetic-solution work as resolution. No author contact is authorized by this issue draft.

Access already achieved: complete six-page original text through author-shared ResearchGate PDF rendition; all six original publisher GIFs from https://ars.els-cdn.com/content/image/1-s2.0-S0032959202000547-gr1.gif through gr6.gif. Direct author-PDF download and public CDN PDF route returned 403; text snapshots and independently acquired graphics are explicitly distinguished from PDF bytes. No supplementary file is referred to by the inspected original; broad exact-DOI/title correction search and Crossref metadata did not identify an amendment in this bounded pass.

This remains a source clarification follow-up. It does not prevent qualified curation, establish an industrial process, or justify silently choosing one conflicting value.

Round81 curation retains this gap; closing requires the scientific acceptance criteria above, not merely merging the qualified records. The source dossier will be linked from the publication PR.
